title: Construction of an Annex Building at the District Hospital

clauses.text: This tender invites sealed bids for the construction of a three-storey annex building at the district hospital, including civil, electrical and plumbing works.
Only contractors registered in Class-A are eligible to bid.
The bidder must have an annual turnover of at least ₹100 crore.
The bidder must have at least 15 years of experience in the construction of similar buildings.
Bids must be submitted within 7 days from the date of publication of this notice.
An Earnest Money Deposit of 2% of the estimated contract value must accompany the bid.
The successful bidder shall complete the work within 18 months of the award of contract.
